we developed an AMV algorithm for the GK-2a satellite, which is similar to that for the MTG satellite.

the development of a new AMV algorithm for GK-2A data, and the results show that the GK-1A algorithm works properly.

the GK-AMV algorithm has been developed, and its quality is comparable to that of other geostationary AMVs.
